zh.title: 订单查不到，AI 数字员工该再发一次吗？
zh.summary: 订单列表为空时，数字员工该重发还是继续查？24 次脚本对照和 6 次真实 Agent 交接，比较空列表、原请求回执和未进入处理确认。

en.title: The order lookup is empty. Should the AI worker send it again?
en.summary: An empty order lookup leaves an AI worker with a choice. Twenty-four scripted runs and six live handoffs compare an empty list, a matching receipt, and definitive non-admission evidence.
